paragraphs.source_en: After the Battle of Ishize against Mizuno Nobumoto ended, Motoyasu and Nobunaga formed an alliance. Now that they were allies, Motoyasu must not encroach upon Oda territory, no matter how small the castle might be.

units.source_en: After the Battle of Ishize against Mizuno Nobumoto ended, Motoyasu and Nobunaga formed an alliance.
units.source_zh: 和水野信元的石濑战役结束后，元康和信长结成了同盟。

units.source_en: Now that they were allies, Motoyasu must not encroach upon Oda territory, no matter how small the castle might be.
units.source_zh: 既已结为盟友，无论城池多么小，元康都不应该侵入织田氏的势力范围。

paragraphs.source_zh: 和水野信元的石濑战役结束后，元康和信长结成了同盟。既已结为盟友，无论城池多么小，元康都不应该侵入织田氏的势力范围。

paragraphs.source_en: Motoyasu's actions further aroused Ujizane's suspicions, and he ordered Itakura Shigesada, Kira Yoshiaki, and Kasuya Zenbei, who were stationed at Nakajima Castle, to resist Motoyasu with all their strength. Motoyasu had no choice but to suppress them in order to strengthen Okazaki Castle's defenses. As a result, more hostages were taken outside Yoshida Castle and put to death.

units.source_en: Motoyasu's actions further aroused Ujizane's suspicions, and he ordered Itakura Shigesada, Kira Yoshiaki, and Kasuya Zenbei, who were stationed at Nakajima Castle, to resist Motoyasu with all their strength.
units.source_zh: 元康的举动越发激起了氏真的疑心，他命令驻守中岛城的板仓重定、吉良义昭和糟谷善兵卫尽力反抗元康。

units.source_en: Motoyasu had no choice but to suppress them in order to strengthen Okazaki Castle's defenses.
units.source_zh: 元康只好镇压，以加强冈崎城的守备。

units.source_en: As a result, more hostages were taken outside Yoshida Castle and put to death.
units.source_zh: 结果，又有人质被推出吉田城外处死。

paragraphs.source_zh: 元康的举动越发激起了氏真的疑心，他命令驻守中岛城的板仓重定、吉良义昭和糟谷善兵卫尽力反抗元康。元康只好镇压，以加强冈崎城的守备。结果，又有人质被推出吉田城外处死。

paragraphs.source_en: Those killed included Ukon, the younger son of Matsudaira Iehiro; Shiro Masayoshi, the grandson of Saigo Masakatsu; the wife and younger sister of Suganuma Shinpachiro; the daughter of Otake Hyoemon; and the wives and children of Okudaira Sadayoshi, Mizuno Tobei, Asaba Sandayu, Okuyama Shuri, and others. All these men were warriors who, after Motoyasu returned to Okazaki Castle, had remembered the old favors of the Matsudaira clan and voluntarily pledged their allegiance to him.

units.source_en: Those killed included Ukon, the younger son of Matsudaira Iehiro; Shiro Masayoshi, the grandson of Saigo Masakatsu; the wife and younger sister of Suganuma Shinpachiro; the daughter of Otake Hyoemon; and the wives and children of Okudaira Sadayoshi, Mizuno Tobei, Asaba Sandayu, Okuyama Shuri, and others.
units.source_zh: 被杀的有松平家广的小儿子右近、西乡正胜的孙子四郎正好、菅沼新八郎的妻子和妹妹、大竹兵右卫门的女儿，以及奥平贞能、水野藤兵卫、浅羽三太夫、奥山修理等人的妻子和儿女。

units.source_en: All these men were warriors who, after Motoyasu returned to Okazaki Castle, had remembered the old favors of the Matsudaira clan and voluntarily pledged their allegiance to him.
units.source_zh: 这些人都是在元康返回冈崎城后，有感于松平氏旧恩而主动归顺的武将。

paragraphs.source_zh: 被杀的有松平家广的小儿子右近、西乡正胜的孙子四郎正好、菅沼新八郎的妻子和妹妹、大竹兵右卫门的女儿，以及奥平贞能、水野藤兵卫、浅羽三太夫、奥山修理等人的妻子和儿女。这些人都是在元康返回冈崎城后，有感于松平氏旧恩而主动归顺的武将。

paragraphs.source_en: It was summer, and the execution ground was Ryunenji Temple below the castle. The cruelty of it made every onlooker blanch; even the retainers of Ohara Hizen-no-kami Sukeyoshi, castellan of Yoshida Castle and overseer of the executions, could not bear to watch.

units.source_en: It was summer, and the execution ground was Ryunenji Temple below the castle.
units.source_zh: 正值夏天，行刑场所是城下的龙拈寺。

units.source_en: The cruelty of it made every onlooker blanch; even the retainers of Ohara Hizen-no-kami Sukeyoshi, castellan of Yoshida Castle and overseer of the executions, could not bear to watch.
units.source_zh: 其残忍程度让旁观者无不失色，就连那监斩官吉田城城代小原肥前守资良的家臣们也不忍目睹。

paragraphs.source_zh: 正值夏天，行刑场所是城下的龙拈寺。其残忍程度让旁观者无不失色，就连那监斩官吉田城城代小原肥前守资良的家臣们也不忍目睹。

paragraphs.source_en: After the slaughter was over, Ujizane declared, “If Motoyasu dares betray us, Lady Sekiguchi, Takechiyo, and Okame will meet the same fate.” This singularly clumsy threat merely drove Motoyasu to resolve upon an early visit to Kiyosu Castle.

units.source_en: After the slaughter was over, Ujizane declared, “If Motoyasu dares betray us, Lady Sekiguchi, Takechiyo, and Okame will meet the same fate.”
units.source_zh: 屠杀结束之后，氏真道：“若元康胆敢背叛我们，那么关口夫人、竹千代和阿龟，都将是同样下场。”

units.source_en: This singularly clumsy threat merely drove Motoyasu to resolve upon an early visit to Kiyosu Castle.
units.source_zh: 这种无比拙劣的威胁，只是促使元康下决心早早访问清洲城。

paragraphs.source_zh: 屠杀结束之后，氏真道：“若元康胆敢背叛我们，那么关口夫人、竹千代和阿龟，都将是同样下场。”这种无比拙劣的威胁，只是促使元康下决心早早访问清洲城。

paragraphs.source_en: His twenty-two attendants, from fifteen-year-old Honda Heihachiro to Uemura Shinrokuro Ujiyoshi, who was nearing sixty, all followed Motoyasu to Kiyosu Castle with the grim resolve of warriors who did not expect to return alive.

units.source_en: His twenty-two attendants, from fifteen-year-old Honda Heihachiro to Uemura Shinrokuro Ujiyoshi, who was nearing sixty, all followed Motoyasu to Kiyosu Castle with the grim resolve of warriors who did not expect to return alive.
units.source_zh: 随从二十二人，从十五岁的本多平八郎到年近六旬的植村新六郎氏义，众人无不抱着壮士一去不返的必死决心，跟随元康抵达了清洲城。

paragraphs.source_zh: 随从二十二人，从十五岁的本多平八郎到年近六旬的植村新六郎氏义，众人无不抱着壮士一去不返的必死决心，跟随元康抵达了清洲城。

paragraphs.source_en: At Nagoya Castle, the party joined the escort sent by Takigawa Kazumasu and then entered Kiyosu under their protection. The townspeople surged toward the Honmachi Gate to watch, leaving the party scarcely able to move.

units.source_en: At Nagoya Castle, the party joined the escort sent by Takigawa Kazumasu and then entered Kiyosu under their protection.
units.source_zh: 一行人在那古野城和泷川一益派来迎接的队伍汇合，随后在他们的保护下进入清洲。

units.source_en: The townspeople surged toward the Honmachi Gate to watch, leaving the party scarcely able to move.
units.source_zh: 城下的百姓纷纷涌到本町门前观看，使得众人寸步难行。

paragraphs.source_zh: 一行人在那古野城和泷川一益派来迎接的队伍汇合，随后在他们的保护下进入清洲。城下的百姓纷纷涌到本町门前观看，使得众人寸步难行。

paragraphs.source_en: Matsudaira Kurodo Motoyasu of Okazaki had come to visit Oda Nobunaga, Lord of Owari, whose fame had thundered across the land after he slew Imagawa Yoshimoto—on hearing the news, the townspeople naturally assumed that Motoyasu had come to submit and curry favor.

units.source_en: Matsudaira Kurodo Motoyasu of Okazaki had come to visit Oda Nobunaga, Lord of Owari, whose fame had thundered across the land after he slew Imagawa Yoshimoto—on hearing the news, the townspeople naturally assumed that Motoyasu had come to submit and curry favor.
units.source_zh: 冈崎的松平藏人元康前来拜访因为斩杀了今川义元而声名大震的尾张之守织田信长——听到这个消息，城下的百姓当然认为元康是来归顺示好的。

paragraphs.source_zh: 冈崎的松平藏人元康前来拜访因为斩杀了今川义元而声名大震的尾张之守织田信长——听到这个消息，城下的百姓当然认为元康是来归顺示好的。

paragraphs.source_en: “Is that the Takechiyo who was sent to Atsuta as a hostage when he was six? I suppose even then he had promised to become an Oda retainer.”

units.source_en: “Is that the Takechiyo who was sent to Atsuta as a hostage when he was six?
units.source_zh: “他就是六岁时便来热田做人质的竹千代吗？

paragraphs.source_en: “Yes. They say Lord Nobunaga often played with him. Lord Oda showed remarkable foresight even then. Truly admirable.”

units.source_en: “Yes.
They say Lord Nobunaga often played with him.
units.source_zh: 听说信长公经常和他一起玩耍。

units.source_en: Lord Oda showed remarkable foresight even then. Truly admirable.”

ja.t: があったのだから、まことに

units.source_zh: 那时的织田大人就有此远见卓识，真让人佩服。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “对。听说信长公经常和他一起玩耍。那时的织田大人就有此远见卓识，真让人佩服。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Even so, Matsudaira Motoyasu cuts a splendid figure on horseback.”

units.source_en: “Even so, Matsudaira Motoyasu cuts a splendid figure on horseback.”
units.source_zh: “虽说如此，但马背上的松平元康很是威风呢。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “虽说如此，但马背上的松平元康很是威风呢。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Once he enters the castle, he is sure to bow and scrape. Let him swagger for now.”

units.source_en: “Once he enters the castle, he is sure to bow and scrape. Let him swagger for now.”

ja.t: れば、きっとぺこぺこするさ。

units.source_zh: “他进城后肯定会卑躬屈膝的，现在姑且让他威风一下。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “他进城后肯定会卑躬屈膝的，现在姑且让他威风一下。”

paragraphs.source_en: Motoyasu neither rebuked nor restrained Tadakatsu. He gazed calmly at Mount Atago beyond the castle and reined in before the Honmachi Gate.

units.source_en: Motoyasu neither rebuked nor restrained Tadakatsu.
units.source_zh: 元康没有训斥，也没有制止忠胜。

units.source_en: He gazed calmly at Mount Atago beyond the castle and reined in before the Honmachi Gate.
units.source_zh: 他平静地眺望着城外的爱宕山，在本町门前停下马。

paragraphs.source_zh: 元康没有训斥，也没有制止忠胜。他平静地眺望着城外的爱宕山，在本町门前停下马。

paragraphs.source_en: “How can I rest easy? They say Owari is full of foxes.” Heihachiro meant everyone to understand his unshakable resolve: if anyone dared attack Motoyasu, he would strike them down without mercy. Kazumasu understood this perfectly, of course, and when Motoyasu dismounted, he bowed his head respectfully in greeting.

units.source_en: “How can I rest easy? They say Owari is full of foxes.”
units.source_zh: “我怎能放心，听说尾张狐狸最多。”

units.source_en: Heihachiro meant everyone to understand his unshakable resolve: if anyone dared attack Motoyasu, he would strike them down without mercy.
units.source_zh: 平八郎想让人明白他坚定的决心：胆敢有人袭击元康，他就杀无赦。

units.source_en: Kazumasu understood this perfectly, of course, and when Motoyasu dismounted, he bowed his head respectfully in greeting.

ja.t: にはもちろんそれがわかっていたので、

units.source_zh: 一益当然清楚，因此当元康从马背上下来时，他恭敬地低头致意。

paragraphs.source_zh: “我怎能放心，听说尾张狐狸最多。”平八郎想让人明白他坚定的决心：胆敢有人袭击元康，他就杀无赦。一益当然清楚，因此当元康从马背上下来时，他恭敬地低头致意。

paragraphs.source_en: The onlookers were all dumbfounded. They thought the Oda clan was being excessively cautious with a party that had come to submit.

units.source_en: The onlookers were all dumbfounded.
units.source_zh: 众人无不目瞪口呆。

units.source_en: They thought the Oda clan was being excessively cautious with a party that had come to submit.
units.source_zh: 他们认为，织田氏对于这支前来归顺的队伍，过于慎重了。

paragraphs.source_zh: 众人无不目瞪口呆。他们认为，织田氏对于这支前来归顺的队伍，过于慎重了。

paragraphs.source_en: Once inside the castle, near the Kamihata Shinmei Shrine, senior retainers including Hayashi Sado, Shibata Katsuie, Niwa Nagahide, and Sugaya Kuroemon were already lined up to receive them. Even the men of Mikawa found this reception deeply gratifying.

units.source_en: Once inside the castle, near the Kamihata Shinmei Shrine, senior retainers including Hayashi Sado, Shibata Katsuie, Niwa Nagahide, and Sugaya Kuroemon were already lined up to receive them.
units.source_zh: 进城到了上畠神明社附近，林佐渡、柴田胜家、丹羽长秀、菅谷九郎右卫门等重臣，已经列队迎候。

units.source_en: Even the men of Mikawa found this reception deeply gratifying.
units.source_zh: 这种待遇连三河人也感到极为满意。

paragraphs.source_zh: 进城到了上畠神明社附近，林佐渡、柴田胜家、丹羽长秀、菅谷九郎右卫门等重臣，已经列队迎候。这种待遇连三河人也感到极为满意。

paragraphs.source_en: Motoyasu bowed with perfect formality. For him, merely crossing this gate meant staking the lives and fortunes of his entire house. If word of this reached Sunpu, the contemptible Ujizane might kill Sena-hime and Takechiyo. At the thought of it, Motoyasu could not have smiled even had he wished to.

units.source_en: Motoyasu bowed with perfect formality.
units.source_zh: 元康规规矩矩施了一礼。

units.source_en: For him, merely crossing this gate meant staking the lives and fortunes of his entire house.
units.source_zh: 对于他来说，踏入这个门，就已经将身家性命当作了赌注。

units.source_en: If word of this reached Sunpu, the contemptible Ujizane might kill Sena-hime and Takechiyo.
units.source_zh: 如果这件事传到骏府，那么卑鄙的氏真可能杀了濑名姬和竹千代。

units.source_en: At the thought of it, Motoyasu could not have smiled even had he wished to.
units.source_zh: 一想到这个，元康即使想笑，也笑不出来了。

paragraphs.source_zh: 元康规规矩矩施了一礼。对于他来说，踏入这个门，就已经将身家性命当作了赌注。如果这件事传到骏府，那么卑鄙的氏真可能杀了濑名姬和竹千代。一想到这个，元康即使想笑，也笑不出来了。

paragraphs.source_en: The undisguised warmth of Nobunaga's welcome filled the men of Mikawa with a comforting glow. But was this truly what Nobunaga felt? The Oda and Matsudaira had been enemies for three generations! Yet this proud commander, who had taken Yoshimoto's head at Dengakuhazama, welcomed Motoyasu inside with reddened eyes, clasping him by the hand.

units.source_en: The undisguised warmth of Nobunaga's welcome filled the men of Mikawa with a comforting glow.
units.source_zh: 信长真情流露的好意，让三河人内心备觉温暖。

units.source_en: But was this truly what Nobunaga felt?
units.source_zh: 可这是信长的真心吗？

units.source_en: The Oda and Matsudaira had been enemies for three generations!
units.source_zh: 织田与松平可是三代为仇啊！

units.source_en: Yet this proud commander, who had taken Yoshimoto's head at Dengakuhazama, welcomed Motoyasu inside with reddened eyes, clasping him by the hand.

paragraphs.source_zh: 信长真情流露的好意，让三河人内心备觉温暖。可这是信长的真心吗？织田与松平可是三代为仇啊！这个在田乐洼取了义元首级的骄傲大将，居然双眼发红地拉着元康的手，把他迎了进去。

paragraphs.source_en: When they entered the reception room in the second enclosure, Takigawa Kazumasu said, “These are your quarters. You may all rest here without concern.”

units.source_en: When they entered the reception room in the second enclosure, Takigawa Kazumasu said, “These are your quarters. You may all rest here without concern.”
units.source_zh: 当他们进入二道城的书院，泷川一益道：“此乃下榻之处，众位可以放心在此歇息。”

paragraphs.source_en: Before the party had even set out, Torii Mototada had warned them, “Do not let down your guard. Those foxes mean to lull us into complacency.”

units.source_en: Before the party had even set out, Torii Mototada had warned them, “Do not let down your guard. Those foxes mean to lull us into complacency.”

paragraphs.source_en: “Let them plot all they please. I will not leave our lord's side for an instant. Even when my lord faces them in person, I will never relinquish this great naginata.” So declared Honda Heihachiro.

paragraphs.source_en: “Matsudaira Motoyasu cast aside the lives of his wife and child to fulfill his ambitions!” If the world reviled him in such terms, then he, Motoyasu, would be a lesser person than his mother, Odai.

units.source_en: If the world reviled him in such terms, then he, Motoyasu, would be a lesser person than his mother, Odai.
units.source_zh: 如果被世人如此谩骂，他元康还不及母亲於大。

paragraphs.source_zh: “松平元康为了实现野心，置妻儿的生死于不顾！”如果被世人如此谩骂，他元康还不及母亲於大。

paragraphs.source_en: Motoyasu knew very well that his mother's efforts had helped make today's meeting and alliance with Nobunaga possible. His mother had labored to influence Mizuno Nobumoto and Hisamatsu Sado for no other reason than to foster an atmosphere of amity between the Matsudaira and Oda houses. The gruesome image of Ujizane having people nailed to death and then hanging their bodies up for public display rose again before Motoyasu's eyes.

units.source_en: Motoyasu knew very well that his mother's efforts had helped make today's meeting and alliance with Nobunaga possible.
units.source_zh: 今日能够顺利地和信长见面、结盟，其中也有母亲的努力，元康对此十分清楚。

paragraphs.source_en: Ujizane was handsome but doll-like, whereas Nobunaga possessed a cold and tranquil presence, austere and imposing like the chilled blade of a sword.
